packageRules.description: Major updates: one PR per package, and never automerged — a breaking change is what a human is for. groupName: null overrides any inherited monorepo group from config:recommended.

Rust compiler: its own reviewable PR, never automerged. A compiler bump lands new default-on clippy lints across the whole crate at once (see rust-toolchain.toml), so it must not ride in a batch. No matchDepNames filter: this manager only reads rust-toolchain.toml, so every dep it produces is the compiler, and a filter that stopped matching would silently demote the bump into another rule. Last rule wins — keep this LAST.
